text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Derby... The Derby...? The Derby, huh. 
Mmmmmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Burnout syndrome." Having achieved her 
major goal of running in the Classics, 
Mejiro Ryan was lacking some focus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Derby! Derby!! I'm gonna do my best at the 
Derby!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Ines Fujin has been training more 
desperately than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help him find a breakthrough, I decided 
to have Mejiro Ryan talk with Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ryan-chan, Trainer, welcome♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines... looks like she's really putting in 
some intense running.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because pulling off a front-running 
victory at Tokyo Racecourse is no small 
feat.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I definitely want to leave behind great 
results. After all, every single miracle 
has finally aligned.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A miracle born of everything...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yup! In the first place, the fact that I 
even made it to Tracen Academy is 
basically a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mom. Well then, I'm off for my first day 
of school!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yes, take care.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about things at home, just go 
and do everything you want with all your 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But are you sure it's okay? We're 
in no position to be generous...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Someone has to look after my little 
sisters...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I appreciate that you're thinking about 
my little sisters. But, you see..."

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Because we can't let Fu-chan's entire life 
end just like that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“I just like running, you know? It's not 
like I have some brilliant future ahead of 
me or anything, right?”

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: Just love is all I need.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if you succeed or not. I just 
want you to chase what you love, even if 
only for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No talent, no pedigree, no freedom— a 
complete lack of everything.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And here I am! I get to run in the Derby, 
where only the chosen few can stand!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Work hard with what little talent I have, 
get into Tracen Academy, and fight my way 
through the Classic Road.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Plus, nothing has happened at home so far! 
This is huge! Even for a short time, it's 
a miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
How could I not get fired up by this? All 
these miracles... If I can just give them 
form...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't mind whatever happens to me♪ 
Just like Ryan-chan when she burned 
herself out in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“I see... That's why you were trying so 
desperately...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan pondered as she looked up at 
the sky. And then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I... had everything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
People called me the hope of the Mejiros, 
and took it for granted that I'd go to 
Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But having no confidence meant I threw it 
all away...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I woke up at the last second, barely made 
it in time, and yet, you're totally burnt 
out in a place like this...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm hopeless, aren't I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As I am right now, I might not even 
deserve to stand in the same starting 
gate.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, you think so~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan, you know what I think? Deep 
down, aren't we all pretty much the same?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Are they similar?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Like not noticing what's important, 
being unstable, or accidentally letting my 
guard down...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Unlike our seniors, everyone's still 
inexperienced... Which means they've got a 
future ahead of them, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've always been with you, so I know. Just 
how brightly you shone whenever you were 
serious, Ryan-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's not like I was always able to 
give it my all either.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So――hey, wanna run? Throwing in everything 
you have, and everything you don't.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's capture this moment. Mac-chan isn't 
here, so I get you all to myself♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Ines. Yeah... Yeah, I got it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna give it my all! To make up for 
all that dawdling around, with everything 
I've got...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As your best friend— I want to show you a 
run worthy of that bond!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A spark reignites within the smoldering 
heart. The second leg of the Classics is 
shaping up to be quite a match.
